items.zh: 我今天没预约，现在还能挂上号吗？
items.scene: 早上八点，患者到门诊大厅问分诊护士

answers.en: I don't have an appointment. Can I still see a doctor today?
answers.note: 先说明没预约，再问当天还能不能看诊，语气直接，适合在分诊台问护士。

answers.en: I didn't make an appointment. Is there any way I can get in today?
answers.note: 用否定句开头，再加上委婉的问法，比直接问更客气，适合号源紧张时试探。

answers.en: Can I get a same-day appointment?
answers.note: 最短，只问当天能不能约上，不解释原因，适合在窗口赶时间时开口。

items.zh: 我没带身份证，还能挂号吗？
items.scene: 患者在挂号窗口翻包时问收费员

answers.en: I don't have my ID with me. Can I still register?
answers.note: 直接说明证件没带，再问还能不能挂号，适合在窗口如实说明情况。

answers.en: I left my ID at home. Is there another way to register?
answers.note: 补上忘在家里这个原因，再问有没有别的办法，比第一条更缓和，也更好商量。

answers.en: Is there any way to see a doctor without an ID?
answers.note: 不说挂号，直接问没证件能不能看诊，比前两条更聚焦结果。

items.zh: 我这几天老是头晕，该挂哪个科？
items.scene: 患者在导诊台前不知道该选哪个科

answers.en: I've been dizzy for the past few days. Which department should I go to?
answers.note: 先讲症状持续几天，再问科室，信息完整，适合在导诊台正常询问。

answers.en: I keep getting dizzy lately. Who should I see?
answers.note: keep getting 强调反复发作，lately 指最近，问 who 比问 department 更口语。

answers.en: I've had dizzy spells for a few days. Which specialist should I see?
answers.note: dizzy spells 指一阵阵眩晕，比前两条更具体，适合想直接找专科医生。

items.zh: 肚子疼得厉害，需要马上检查吗？
items.scene: 患者捂着肚子在急诊诊室问医生

answers.en: My stomach really hurts. Do I need to get it checked right away?
answers.note: 直说疼得厉害，再问是否要立刻检查，语气焦急但叙述完整，适合急诊。

answers.en: I have severe stomach pain. Do I need tests right now?
answers.note: 用 severe stomach pain 和 tests，比第一条更像医学描述，适合快速说明。

answers.en: My stomach is killing me. Should I get checked right away?
answers.note: is killing me 是夸张口语，情绪比前两条强，适合疼得受不了时。

items.zh: 孩子烧到三十九度，要不要现在去急诊？
items.scene: 晚上十点，家长在社区医院问值班医生

answers.en: My kid has a fever of 39 degrees. Should we go to the ER now?
answers.note: 用 kid 和 ER，日常口语，向值班医生说明体温并问要不要去急诊。

answers.en: My child's temperature is 39 degrees Celsius. Should we take them to the ER tonight?
answers.note: 用 temperature 和 Celsius，比 kid 那句更正式，像向医护准确汇报体温。

answers.en: My kid's running a 39-degree fever. Should we head to the ER?
answers.note: running a fever 和 head to 都很口语，比前两条更随意，适合着急时商量。

items.zh: 退烧药吃了两个小时，怎么还没退？
items.scene: 患者家属在病房问值班护士

answers.en: He took the fever reducer two hours ago. Why hasn't his fever come down?
answers.note: 说 fever reducer 和 come down，叙述清楚，适合向护士说明时间和现状。

answers.en: It's been two hours since he took medicine for his fever. Why is his fever still high?
answers.note: It's been 强调已经过了两小时，比第一条更关注等待时间，语气略急。

answers.en: He took something for his fever two hours ago. Why isn't it working?
answers.note: something 不点明药名，isn't it working 带不满，情绪比前两条强。

items.zh: 咳嗽快两周了，会不会是肺炎？
items.scene: 患者在呼吸科诊室向医生说出担忧

answers.en: I've been coughing for almost two weeks. Could it be pneumonia?
answers.note: 平铺直叙说明时长，再问可能性，语气中性，适合初诊时询问。

answers.en: I've had this cough for nearly two weeks. Is there a chance it's pneumonia?
answers.note: Is there a chance 比 could it be 更委婉，表示只是担心，不想下结论。

answers.en: This cough's been hanging around for two weeks. Do you think it could be pneumonia?
answers.note: hanging around 指咳嗽拖着不走，Do you think 更像当面求证，适合熟悉的医生。

items.zh: 晚上咳得睡不着，有什么办法缓解吗？
items.scene: 患者在线上问诊时向医生求助

answers.en: I can't sleep at night because of this cough. Is there anything I can do to ease it?
answers.note: 完整说明咳嗽影响睡眠，再问缓解办法，语气礼貌，适合线上问诊。

answers.en: This cough keeps me up at night. Any way to get some relief?
answers.note: keeps me up 和 Any way 省略主语，比第一条更短更随口，适合打字提问。

answers.en: The coughing is so bad at night that I can't sleep. What can I do about it?
answers.note: so bad that 强调严重程度，问法最开放，适合希望医生多给建议。

items.zh: 吃了海鲜后起疹子，是过敏吗？
items.scene: 患者指着手臂红疹在急诊问医生

answers.en: I broke out in a rash after eating seafood. Is it an allergic reaction?
answers.note: broke out in a rash 很常见，问 allergic reaction 较准确，适合急诊描述。

answers.en: I got a rash after I ate seafood. Could I be allergic?
answers.note: got a rash 和 Could I be 更简单，比第一条少一点判断，重点在确认过敏。

answers.en: I've had a rash all over my arms since I ate seafood. Is this an allergy?
answers.note: all over my arms 强调范围，直接把疹子指给医生看，问法最直白。

items.zh: 我对青霉素过敏，病历上写了吗？
items.scene: 患者住院前在护士站确认过敏记录

answers.en: I'm allergic to penicillin. Is that on my chart?
answers.note: chart 指医院病历，问法直接，适合在护士站核对过敏记录。

answers.en: I have a penicillin allergy. Did anyone note that in my records?
answers.note: 用 records，比 chart 那句更正式，还追问有没有人记录过。

answers.en: I react badly to penicillin. Is that written down anywhere?
answers.note: react badly 比前两条更口语，anywhere 带一点不放心的追问感。

items.zh: 医生让我拍个片子，放射科在几楼？
items.scene: 患者拿着检查单在住院部一楼问导医

answers.en: The doctor ordered an X-ray. Which floor is radiology on?
answers.note: ordered an X-ray 是医院常用说法，直接问楼层，适合拿检查单问路。

answers.en: I'm supposed to get an X-ray. Where's the radiology department?
answers.note: be supposed to 表示医生安排，问科室位置，比第一条问得更宽泛。

answers.en: I need an X-ray. How do I get to radiology?
answers.note: 最短，只问怎么走，比前两条更直接，适合已经知道大概方向时。

items.zh: 拍片前要把项链摘掉吗？
items.scene: 患者在放射科检查室门口问技师

answers.en: Do I need to take off my necklace before the X-ray?
answers.note: 直接问项链要不要摘，take off 很日常，适合进检查室前确认。

answers.en: Should I remove my jewelry for the scan?
answers.note: jewelry 统称首饰，remove 较正式，比单问项链涵盖更广。

answers.en: Does this necklace need to come off?
answers.note: 以项链为主语，比前两条更随意，像顺口一问，适合已经准备检查时。

items.zh: 抽血前能喝水吗？
items.scene: 患者早上在检验科窗口问采血护士

answers.en: Can I drink water before the blood test?
answers.note: 最普通的问法，只确认喝水这件事，适合采血前随口问。

answers.en: Am I allowed to have water before the blood draw?
answers.note: Am I allowed 更正式，像在确认规定，比第一条多一层请示。

answers.en: Is it okay to drink water before they take blood?
answers.note: Is it okay 轻松，用 they 指采血人员，比前两条更像聊天。

items.zh: 抽完血多久能拿到结果？
items.scene: 患者按着棉签在采血窗口问护士

answers.en: How long will it take to get the results?
answers.note: 问拿到结果要多久，重点在时长，适合刚抽完血时确认。

answers.en: When will my blood test results be ready?
answers.note: 问结果什么时候准备好，比第一条更关注具体时间点，适合安排行程。

answers.en: How soon can I pick up the results?
answers.note: pick up 强调回来取报告，比前两条更具体到领取这件事。

items.zh: 这个药一天吃几次？
items.scene: 患者拿着处方在药房窗口问药师

answers.en: How many times a day should I take this?
answers.note: 最直白，问一天吃几次，适合拿药时快速确认。

answers.en: How often do I take this medication?
answers.note: how often 问间隔频率，比第一条正式，答案可能是每隔几小时。

answers.en: How many doses a day do I take?
answers.note: doses 指一次的药量，问一天几剂，适合对照药盒上的说明。

items.zh: 这药吃了会犯困吗？
items.scene: 患者取药时担心白天上班受影响

answers.en: Will this medicine make me sleepy?
answers.note: 直接问会不会犯困，语气中性，适合在药房窗口顺口确认。

answers.en: Does this medication cause drowsiness?
answers.note: cause drowsiness 是说明书式说法，比第一条正式，适合确认副作用。

answers.en: Is this going to knock me out?
answers.note: knock me out 是夸张口语，指困得撑不住，语气比前两条重。

items.zh: 抗生素必须吃完整个疗程吗？
items.scene: 患者拿着药盒在诊室问医生

answers.en: Do I have to finish the whole course of antibiotics?
answers.note: 标准问法，直接问是不是要吃完疗程，适合开药时确认。

answers.en: Should I take all the antibiotics, even if I feel better?
answers.note: 补上即使好转也要不要吃完，比第一条更具体，重点在症状消失以后。

answers.en: Do I really have to finish every last pill?
answers.note: every last pill 强调一颗不剩，really 带点不情愿，比前两条更像讨价还价。

items.zh: 下周三来复诊需要重新挂号吗？
items.scene: 患者看完诊在诊室门口问护士

answers.en: Do I need to register again for my follow-up next Wednesday?
answers.note: 直接问复诊是不是要重新挂号，适合刚看完诊、在门口确认流程。

answers.en: For my follow-up next Wednesday, do I have to make a new appointment?
answers.note: 把复诊时间放句首，比第一条更强调那次预约，问要不要重新约。

answers.en: When I come back next Wednesday, should I check in again?
answers.note: check in 指到院报到，和挂号不是一回事，比前两条更关注到院第一步。

items.zh: 伤口恢复得不错，还用再来复诊吗？
items.scene: 患者拆线后在外科诊室问医生

answers.en: The wound is healing well. Do I still need to come back for a follow-up?
answers.note: 先陈述恢复情况再问是否复诊，语气稳妥，适合拆线后常规确认。

answers.en: It looks like it's healing nicely. Should I schedule another visit?
answers.note: looks like 留有余地，schedule 比 come back 更主动，重点在预约下次。

answers.en: Since it's healing well, can I skip the follow-up?
answers.note: skip 带试探意味，比前两条更直接，适合希望省一趟时。

items.zh: 异地看病医保能报销吗？
items.scene: 患者在医保窗口咨询异地就医政策

answers.en: Can I use my insurance if I see a doctor in another city?
answers.note: use my insurance 问能不能用，口语直接，适合在窗口先问大方向。

answers.en: Does my health insurance cover me when I'm away from home?
answers.note: cover me 是保险说法，away from home 指离开常住地，比第一条正式。

answers.en: Does my insurance work out of town?
answers.note: work out of town 很口语，比前两条更短，适合先快速打听。

items.zh: 医保卡里的钱够付这次检查费吗？
items.scene: 患者缴费前在收费窗口问工作人员

answers.en: Is there enough on my insurance card to cover this test?
answers.note: 问卡里的钱够不够付检查费，说法直接，适合收费窗口确认。

answers.en: Do I have enough balance on my insurance card for this test?
answers.note: balance 指卡内余额，比第一条更具体，适合想听明确数字。

answers.en: Will my insurance card cover the cost of this test, or do I need to pay?
answers.note: 把要不要自费也一起问出来，比前两条更周全，适合担心还要补钱。

items.zh: 网上挂的号到医院还要取号吗？
items.scene: 患者第一次用手机挂号，到大厅问志愿者

answers.en: I booked online. Do I still need to check in when I get here?
answers.note: booked online 说明网上预约，问还要不要报到，适合第一次来医院。

answers.en: I booked through the app. Do I need to get a number at the front desk?
answers.note: booked through the app 说明手机预约，number 指排队号，问是否要现场取号。

answers.en: I signed up online — can I go straight to the doctor?
answers.note: 问能不能直接去找医生，比前两条更随意，隐含想跳过取号。

items.zh: 昨晚摔了一跤，现在手腕肿了，要拍片吗？
items.scene: 患者托着手腕在急诊诊室问医生

answers.en: I fell last night and my wrist is swollen. Do I need an X-ray?
answers.note: 按时间顺序说摔倒和肿胀，再问拍片，叙述清楚，适合急诊。

answers.en: I took a fall last night, and now my wrist is all swollen. Should I get it X-rayed?
answers.note: took a fall 和 all swollen 更口语，比第一条更随意，get it X-rayed 强调处理。

answers.en: My wrist's been swollen since I fell last night. Is an X-ray necessary?
answers.note: has been 强调肿胀一直没消，问 necessary 偏正式，更像在确认医生判断。

items.zh: 输液的时候手有点疼，要不要叫护士？
items.scene: 患者在输液室小声问陪护的家属

answers.en: My hand hurts a little from the IV. Should I call the nurse?
answers.note: 说明只是轻微疼痛再问要不要叫护士，语气平静，适合先跟家属商量。

answers.en: This IV's making my hand hurt — do you think it's bad enough to get the nurse?
answers.note: 把判断交给对方，问疼到什么程度才叫护士，比第一条更犹豫。

answers.en: My hand's kind of sore where the needle is. Should I flag down a nurse?
answers.note: sore 指酸痛，flag down 指向路过的护士招手，语气比前两条更轻。

items.zh: 这个药能跟降压药一起吃吗？
items.scene: 患者拿着新处方在药房咨询药师

answers.en: Can I take this with my blood pressure medication?
answers.note: 直接问能不能和降压药同服，说法日常，适合药房窗口确认。

answers.en: Is it safe to take this along with my blood pressure pills?
answers.note: is it safe 和 pills 比第一条更强调安全性，也稍微口语一点。

answers.en: Will this interact with my blood pressure meds?
answers.note: interact 是专业说法，meds 又很口语，比前两条更适合听药师解释。
